newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Uralsvyazinform plans 0.23 rbl Q3 dividend - agency.
newsitem.headline: Uralsvyazinform plans 0.23 rbl Q3 dividend - agency.

text.p: Russian telecommunications company AO Uralsvyazinform will pay a third-quarter dividend of 0.23 roubles on each of its 100-rouble shares, Interfax news agency said on Friday.
The Perm-based company paid out 1.1 roubles in the first quarter and two roubles in the second quarter on shares of 500 rouble nominal value, Interfax said.
The shares were split in July after two separate increases in Uralsvyazinform's charter capital.
The company, in which the Svyazinvest holding has a controlling stake, said last month it planned to file the necessary documents in early November to issue Level One American Depositary Receipts.
Uralsvyazinform's charter capital is 912 billion roubles.
